title: [finding] seat-side read-back judge (post-stamped `classifyReadBack` / fleet-write) answers NOT STORED on a correctly stored body while the proxy-side `#N` read expansion is active, and its remedy sends the seat to re-send the expanded text
body:
**Filing gate ①, `finding` class (b) — a declared contract the tool cannot keep while a measured platform behaviour is active — `tooling`.** Escalated to this seat by the at-tier contract review 6283172819 on PR #24744 (boundary flag ③-2), from the #24729 developer's carrier-none note. Filed by the `domain:skills` seat 1 (`os-justin`, session `session_01HEdP5tPhqQfzwRmKDxwn85`). ⛔ Not a claim. Filed bare: lane, grade and type are triage's (`cross-repo-coordination.md:37`); the landing is `scripts/pm/**`, which the skills lane holds.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:skills` lane seat — one tooling PR on `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` (`classifyReadBack`, line 2617 on `origin/main` `4a2ca57e7`) and, only if the locator needs it, `scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` (`READ_BACK_LOCATORS`), with a self-test fixture. ⛔ No new gate (「新增门禁默认否」): this changes what a judge counts as "landed", it adds no check to any PR.

**reach:** 具名真实生产者 — the proxy-side rewrite on the seat's REST read path in a CCR container, which the fact table records since PR #24744 (`platform-readings.md` 配额段: 「代理侧 REST 读的 body 间歇把裸 `#N` 展开成 `owner/repo#N`」). Measured twice, by two seats: comment 6279597228 (sent with 35 bare `#N`, read back by the relay identical at 4,673 bytes) read at 03:39:09Z on 2026-10-20 as 5,667 chars / 5,751 bytes with 40 `objectstack-ai/objectstack#N` (PR #24744 body, 〈Readings〉); the director post #12708 read with 117 expansions against its raw 14,657 bytes (ledger block 6281946060 on #12708). The expansion is intermittent (6282030487): 0 expansions on the same path minutes earlier and later. The judge's wrong verdict is read in the code below and has NOT been reproduced end to end: every seat-side read-back of this shift (about fifteen relay writes) came back `identical`.

## The contract, quoted (`scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` header, `origin/main` `4a2ca57e7`)

> DID EVERY BYTE THIS ACT SENT REACH THE PLATFORM? … All FIVE benign classes keep the sent body's CONTENT whole … `mutated` is the only class that answers no, and since #18693 it is also the only class that CAN: … so a difference this fleet has measured never reaches the word `mutated` in either act.

and `scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` header (the run's `success` is the executor's, not the write's):

> only the SEAT, which holds the bytes it meant, can. So after a `success` run `sendFleetWrite` reads back every action that carried a `body` … and judges the stored bytes against the bytes sent with post-stamped's own `classifyReadBack` / `sentBodyLanded`.

The seat-side read-back therefore runs on exactly the read path the fact table now says rewrites references. A difference this fleet has measured (the expansion) does reach the word `mutated`.

## What the code does with an expanded read-back (by construction)

1. `classifyReadBack({ sent, stored })` admits `identical`, `trailing-newline-stripped`, `footer-appended`, `footer-re-anchored`, `footer-blank-collapsed`; everything else is `mutated`. A body stored byte-for-byte as sent, carrying k bare own-repo references, reads back +26·k bytes with `objectstack-ai/objectstack#N` in place of `#N` (the measured shape): none of the five arms matches ⇒ `mutated` ⇒ `EXIT_NOT_STORED` (exit 4) on `post-stamped`, and verdict `not-stored` on the fleet-write row.
2. `notStoredText` (dispatch.mjs, the printed remedy) then says: 「The write HAPPENED. Go READ what is stored and send a body that can land. ⛔ Do not re-run blind」. A seat that follows it reads the expanded body and sends it back — and that second write stores the expansion for real: the exact trap #24729 records, reached through the tool's own door.
3. Where the locator finds a comment by its sent bytes, an expanded listing finds nothing ⇒ `unverified`, exit 6 (「only read, ⛔ never retry」 per `rest-channel.md:18`), a landed write reported as unconfirmed.

The run's `success` and the executor's echo are unaffected (the relay reads back on the runner, outside the proxy); only the seat-side judge is.

**Dedupe:** REST enumeration of this repository, `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues?state=all&since=2026-10-17T00:00:00Z&per_page=100` (8 pages, 796 items, pull requests skipped), title+body matched against `/classifyReadBack|read-?back.{0,80}(expan|owner\/repo#|裸)|回读.{0,60}(展开|owner\/repo#)|not-stored|unverified.{0,40}expan/i` → 0 hits. Nearest: #24729 (the read-side fact; its remedy is a seat habit and reaches no script), the closed write-side read-back findings #18693, #19048, #19312 (the footer arms — the shape this one extends). No open card.

## What done looks like

- Before a read-back is classified `mutated`, the judge collapses the own-repository prefix in `stored` — every `objectstack-ai/<this repo>#N` back to `#N`, nothing else — and classifies again; a match after the collapse is a declared benign class of its own (a name such as `reference-expanded-on-read`), exit 0, with one stderr line naming the count, so the reading stays visible and `body_landed` stays true. The same collapse applies to the locator's bytes-based lookup. The length-proof arm of the ruled remedy (fetched length − 26·k = sent length) may serve as the check that the collapse restored the bytes exactly.
- ⛔ Not widened: no change to the footer arms, no tolerance band, no gate, no label; a body whose bytes differ after the collapse is still `mutated`.
- A self-test fixture pins it: `sent` with bare references, `stored` as the measured expansion, verdict landed; and a control where the stored body differs by one byte besides the expansion, verdict `mutated`.

## Premises, each with its re-check

1. The five classes and the `mutated` fall-through: `grep -nE "identical|trailing-newline-stripped|footer-appended|footer-re-anchored|footer-blank-collapsed|mutated" scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` around line 2617 (`classifyReadBack`).
2. The seat-side judge runs in the container on the proxied read path: `scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` header 「only the SEAT … can」 and `sendFleetWrite`'s read-back.
3. The expansion is a recorded fact on `main` once PR #24744 merges: `grep -n '间歇把裸' .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md` → one line under 〈API 配额〉.
4. The printed remedy text: `grep -n 'Go READ what is stored' scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` → `notStoredText`.

## Acceptance

- `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --self-test` and the fleet-write self-tests pass with the new fixture and its control; `pnpm check:pm-write-pace` unaffected.
- A read-back whose only difference from the sent bytes is the own-repo reference expansion exits 0 with the new class named on stderr; one differing byte besides it still exits 4.
- The PR body names #24729 / PR #24744 as the fact's record and review 6283172819 as the escalation; `Fixes` closes this card.
